# Mathematics coverage

<!-- Generated by tools/coverage.py. Edit mathematics-coverage.json instead. -->

An initial, explicitly scoped survey and tested implementation. Not a census of all mathematics and not a proof of universality.

Representation status applies only to each record's explicit scope. Catalog-only rows are initial triage, not established minimality results. Native registrations use Algebra and the existing operations interfaces; the optional Domain/Structure prototype does not execute those registrations. Implementation, empirical testing and mathematical proof are independent axes.

Each row is a scoped assessment, not a unit of all known mathematics. No universal coverage percentage is defined. CATALOG_ONLY records are provisional triage, not working implementations. MACHINE_TESTED counts linked implementation scopes; it does not count independent tests or certify an entire field. Sources aid discovery and do not certify these mappings.

## Open extensions

- [certified-laws](RFC_LAWS_AND_EQUIVALENCE.md): Law statements and finite tests do not establish universally quantified laws, extensional equality or proof obligations.
- [analytic-membership](RFC_INFINITE_AND_ANALYTIC_DOMAINS.md): Smoothness, convergence, completeness and integrability cannot be inferred from an arbitrary executable callback or a finite prefix.
- [measure-semantics](RFC_INFINITE_AND_ANALYTIC_DOMAINS.md): General measures require measurable spaces, countable additivity and almost-everywhere equivalence; finite weights alone lose this meaning.
- [dependent-domains](RFC_DEPENDENT_DOMAINS.md): The carrier or result membership depends on a value such as a base point, dimension, parameter or geometric base object.
- [quotients](RFC_LAWS_AND_EQUIVALENCE.md): Representatives must be identified under an explicit equivalence and operations must descend independently of representative choice.
- [symbolic-backends](RFC_EXTERNAL_MATHEMATICAL_SYSTEMS.md): Exact algebraic/spectral objects need certified symbolic representations and algorithms beyond the rational subset shipped here.
- [solution-certificates](RFC_EXTERNAL_MATHEMATICAL_SYSTEMS.md): A candidate solution does not establish existence, uniqueness, completeness of a solution family or numerical convergence.
- [gluing](RFC_DEPENDENT_DOMAINS.md): Local data, restriction maps and gluing/descent conditions are essential; a finite set of points or labels loses this structure.
- [higher-coherence](CATEGORY_THEORY_ANALYSIS.md): Objects and arrows alone omit identities, composability, equality, universe size and (for higher cases) coherence data.
